verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion controls are a fair question for an error-tracking and observability SaaS, but the pack documents no user-configurable retention periods and no way to delete error or event data. The only nearby item (docs-22) says Business/Enterprise accounts can replicate Insights data elsewhere to keep it longer than Honeybadger stores it. That is an adjacent export feature implying fixed vendor retention, not control over retention or deletion, so it earns no credit.
